description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the accuracy of a model and the frequency of pop frequency, measured in units of 10^4. The x-axis is labeled "pop frequency (x10^4)" and is scaled linearly, with values ranging from 0 to 19, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and is scaled linearly as well, with values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. There are two lines in the plot: the green line represents the "Initial Accuracy," and the blue line represents the "Final Accuracy." The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.4 at a pop frequency of 0, peaks at around 0.8 at a pop frequency of 3, and then generally trends downward, ending at an accuracy of about 0.6 at a pop frequency of 19. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.8 at a pop frequency of 0, shows a general upward trend, peaking at around 1.0 at a pop frequency of 3, and then fluctuates with a slight downward trend, ending at an accuracy of about 0.9 at a pop frequency of 19.
